summary: Provision Mixpanel pilot: allocate 50 paid seats, enable SCIM/SSO, and complete vendor security onboarding
description:
Issue summary:
Request to procure and onboard Mixpanel Advanced plan for a 6-week product analytics pilot. The pilot will span Product, Growth, and Platform teams and requires 50 seat entitlements, SCIM provisioning from Okta, SSO configuration (SAML), and completion of the vendor security questionnaire (TPRM).

Impact:
- Product/Growth cannot run the event-instrumentation pilot without seats and SCIM mapping.
- Delay blocks data-driven feature prioritization for Q2 metrics.

Business justification:
- Expected to accelerate funnel analysis and reduce ad-hoc instrumentation time; alternative evaluation (internal Redash + custom pipelines) has higher infra cost and slower iteration.

Requested deliverables:
1) Purchase 50 Mixpanel paid seats (monthly billing; tag to ENG-PLATFORM).
2) Create Mixpanel admin account and transfer billing ownership to Finance-Payments team.
3) Complete vendor security questionnaire and confirm SOC2/ISO claims; capture evidence URLs in the Confluence page above.
4) Configure SCIM sync from Okta with group-to-team mapping and test provisioning for representative users from Product, Growth, Platform.
5) Configure SAML SSO with IdP metadata and enforce SSO for all accounts.
6) Deliver a seat entitlement spreadsheet (CSV) with user->team->cost-center mapping and a rotation policy for contractors.

Approvals required:
- Finance (cost center sign-off)
- Security/TPRM (vendor risk acceptance)
- Legal (standard SaaS terms; review for data processing addendum)

Steps & notes so far:
- Product (reporter) completed feature-use case and event list: linked Confluence doc.
- Procurement requested vendor quote on 2026-03-12; vendor returned standard pricing and a draft MSA.
- Security performed initial questionnaire review and flagged data retention/PII processing entries for clarification (see comment thread).
- Okta team confirmed SCIM support and provided an App template to test.

Attachments/links:
- Mixpanel quote PDF (uploaded to Confluence page).
- Draft MSA (vendor) in /legal/review (Confluence link above).
- Okta SCIM App template PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/idp-config/pull/88

Timeline:
- Goal: Provision seats + SCIM & SSO test accounts by 2026-03-20 to start instrumentation on 2026-03-23.

Acceptance criteria:
- 50 seats are active and billed to ENG-PLATFORM with an invoice record saved to Finance.
- SCIM provision and deprovision flows tested end-to-end for 3 users per team.
- SSO enforced and documented with IdP metadata and a rollback plan.
- Security/TPRM publishes a risk acceptance or required mitigations.

Notes on sensitive data handling:
- Mixpanel ingestion will include hashed user identifiers and event metadata; Security requires vendor confirmation that PII will not be stored in cleartext and that deletion requests are supported.

Resolution notes (current):
- Procurement has received the vendor invoice and issued a PO draft.
- Okta team completed a SCIM test run against a sandbox tenant (3/13).
- Security asked vendor for data retention SLA clarification and example DPA clause; vendor responded 3/14 and legal is reviewing.
- Remaining blocker: Legal needs to sign DPA addendum and Security to close outstanding TPRM items before full seat activation.

2026-03-14 10:05 - Lucia Perez (Legal): On review. Draft MSA has standard SaaS terms; working with vendor counsel to add a narrow DPA paragraph and a 45-day retention commitment for raw events. Targeting signoff by 2026-03-17.
2026-03-14 15:30 - Asha Mehta (Reporter): Provided the final list of 50 seat recipients to Diego in the spreadsheet (link on Confluence). Please confirm seat mapping after Finance tags the invoice.

2026-03-14 16:12 - Diego Alvarez (Procurement): Noted. Will hold seat activation until Legal confirms DPA. If Legal approves by 3/17, we can activate a subset (20 seats) earlier for Product to begin critical instrumentation while the remainder are staged.

2026-03-14 16:45 - Mark Chen (Security): Approved conditional pilot activation of 20 seats with strict event sampling and no PII ingestion until DPA signed. Security will run a one-week audit of ingested events for the pilot cohort.
2026-03-14 17:02 - Asha Mehta (Reporter): Acknowledged. Will coordinate with Product to start with the 20-seat cohort on 3/23 and share event filters for Security review.
resolution: Awaiting Legal DPA signoff; conditional 20-seat pilot approved by Security

Okta to run production SCIM sync after DPA
